title: Dance With Me Soundtrack CD Epic Records Group Sony Music Mandalay Entertainment
descriptionText: The Dance With Me Soundtrack CD features various artists and is a compilation of songs from the musical-style genre of soundtracks and musicals. Released under the Epic Records label and produced by Sony Music and Mandalay Entertainment, this CD includes tracks from the album "Dance with Me" that will surely captivate listeners with its captivating melodies and tunes. Perfect for music lovers who enjoy the fusion of musical theater and contemporary hits, this CD is a must-have for anyone who loves the sound of musicals.
